_comment: ThreePlayerTicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is.

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, one of A, B or C
_slots.{row}: The board row index of the placed mark
_slots.{col}: The board column index of the placed mark
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board (do not translate)
_slots.{moves}: The comma-separated list of available move tokens like '[4]' (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Uwe mwari {player_id} katika Tic Tac Toe ya watu watatu.
Alama yako ni '{symbol}'.
Unachukua mabadiliko kuweka alama yako kwenye bamba la 5x5 kuunda mstari wa nne.
Mistari inaweza kuwa ya usawa, wima, au diagonal.
Wasilisha kuhamia kwa kutumia fomu '[4]' ili kuchora seli 4.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Uburyo bwo kwimuka budafise agaciro. Koresha "[cell]" aho agace ari 0-{max_cell} .
invalid_move.out_of_range: Inombolo y'urupapuro idakwiye: {cell}. Itegerezwa kuba iri hagati ya 0 na {max_cell} .

game_action.placed: Mwari {player_id} anaweka alama yake ({symbol}) kwenye uwanja ({row}, {col}).
